graph_findings: Unprofiled device login coupled with distance jump of 1250 km and proxy IP flag
policy_rules_evaluated: Policy Rule §4.2.1: Model score >= 0.82 warrants immediate transaction soft-hold.
Policy Rule §4.2.3: Elevated risk requires controlled step-up authentication prior to release.

uncertainty_assessment.evidence_gap_identified: Transaction originates from an unprofiled device fingerprint. Unable to determine if cardholder upgraded device or credentials were compromised.

controlled_evidence_gathering.notes: Controlled evidence inquiry returned: FAILED_OR_EXPIRED | Customer response: CONFIRMED_FRAUD

before_additional_evidence.rationale: High uncertainty due to unrecognized hardware device. Placing temporary hold while triggering automated step-up biometric prompt.

after_additional_evidence.rationale: Additional evidence resolved uncertainty: Step-up authentication failed and customer repudiated charge. Confirmed unauthorized Account Takeover.

humanized_briefing.story: We observed an unusual attempt to debit $3,450.00 on CUST_5011's account. The transaction came from an unprofiled device located 1,250 km away from their regular location. Because legitimate customers occasionally travel or upgrade their devices, we didn't want to immediately strand them with a cold block. We initiated a safe 24-hour soft hold and reached out for step-up verification.
humanized_briefing.empathy_assessment: We balanced financial loss prevention with customer sentiment. Cold declines on honest customers create friction and churn. By staging decisions into Pre-Evidence (protect & verify) and Post-Evidence (defensible resolution), we safeguard the bank while treating customers with respect.
analyst_talking_points: If customer contacts support: Confirm they recognize the $3,450.00 charge.
Explain that our security systems placed a proactive protective hold to keep their funds safe.
If verified legitimate, their card can be released instantly with zero negative marks on their record.

customer_outreach.sms_text: Apex Bank Security: Hi, did you just attempt a $3,450.00 purchase? To protect your account, we've temporarily paused this charge. Reply YES if this was you, or NO to secure your card immediately.

push_notification.body: Was this you? A $3,450.00 charge requires your one-tap approval.

customer_outreach.support_agent_greeting: Hello! Thank you for calling Apex Bank Security. I see our automated monitoring system placed a temporary courtesy hold on a $3,450.00 charge to keep your account safe. I'm here to help you get this resolved in just a moment.
